unlicensed_multicarts.title: Action 52
unlicensed_multicarts.enumeration_note: archive.org item description and an archived 2008-10 TIGSource remake sign-up sheet list the same 52 games in the same order; spellings differ slightly and neither is the cartridge menu itself.
evidence: https://web.archive.org/web/2010/http://www.superfundungeonrun.com/action52/index.php (TIGSource "Action 52 Owns" remake sign-up list; saved raw/pass2/sfdr-action52.html)

unlicensed_multicarts.title: Caltron 6 in 1
unlicensed_multicarts.enumeration_note: Caltron 6 in 1 article enumerates the games; HES article says Real Players Pak has "the same unique games"; NesCartDB has standalone Spanish Gluk Video carts for Cosmos Cop, Adan y Eva, Booky Man, Balloon Monster.
notes: Myriad 6 in 1 = leftover Caltron stock relabelled by Myriad Games, identical program (Caltron article): a second product covering the same identities.
Components were previously released standalone only in Famicom format by NTDEC (non-NA), so in NA they are multicart-only.

unlicensed_multicarts.title: Maxi 15
unlicensed_multicarts.enumeration_note: AVE article enumerates 15 games; 14 are corroborated as standalone AVE/AGC/Color Dreams U.S. releases.
notes: Whether the 14 overlapping games are byte-identical to their standalone carts is not established (R-M03, ownership only).

unlicensed_multicarts.title: Quattro Adventure
unlicensed_multicarts.enumeration_note: Quattro compilations and Aladdin Deck Enhancer articles list the same four games.
notes: Release year conflict: Quattro article infobox 1991; Super Robin Hood article says Quattro Adventure released it in 1993.
Standard and Aladdin compact-cart products exist (PriceCharting).

unlicensed_multicarts.title: Quattro Arcade
unlicensed_multicarts.enumeration_note: Quattro compilations article lists all four; Aladdin article confirms CJ's Elephant Antics is on Quattro Arcade and lists F16 Renegade / Go! Dizzy Go! as not released as Aladdin carts.

unlicensed_multicarts.title: Sunday Funday
unlicensed_multicarts.enumeration_note: Wikipedia (Menace Beach article) and TCRF both document the cart menu: the main game (a reskin of Menace Beach), Fish Fall / "Fishfall" (a rendition of the unreleased Color Dreams game Free Fall) and a karaoke track of 4Him's "The Ride" (not a game).
notes: Main game = Menace Beach identity (R-U05b). The karaoke track is non-game content and creates no identity.
evidence: https://web.archive.org/web/20250821064142/https://tcrf.net/Menace_Beach (The Cutting Room Floor, archived 2025-08-21; saved raw/pass3/)

unlicensed_multicarts.title: Quattro Sports
unlicensed_multicarts.enumeration_note: Both articles list the same four games; the tennis game is "Tennis Simulator" (Quattro article) vs "Pro Tennis" (Aladdin article).
notes: Standard and Aladdin compact-cart products exist (PriceCharting).
